newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUALAND WEST WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUALAND WEST WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.

chose to bat in the one-day match against India at Kimberley
